question: What ornamental and structural elements are placed on the spire pair and corner?
premises: An ornament is placed on the pair of spires.
The corner position is also specified.
Two pratirathas are associated with the corner.
inference: An ornament is placed on the spire pair and two pratirathas are placed at the corner.
uncertainties: The token pratirathyakaḥ is singular in form but is taken with dve as indicating two pratirathas.
plain_english: Place an ornament on the pair of spires, and place two pratirathas at the corner.
